discipline: dungeon-jev v2 — the legality mask (wired BEFORE collapse) + the GAP-GATE rerun; patches named by this repo's own JEV-WAVE-1 honest null (83e4856)
sealedBefore: any model call of this wave, any v2 run — the jepa gold standard; wave-1 claims (73-c, claimsHash sha256:6b4f803e...) and its receipts are UNTOUCHED history; v2 scores beside them

instrument.engine: the vendored core src/dungeon.js (byte-frozen, batteryBinding below) — same engine as wave-1
instrument.mask: the upstream typed legality mask, vendored verbatim from quilt-dungeons@6740b59 (CONTRACT v1.1.0 §6.5) into src/v2-mask.js: a cardinal action is legal iff its target cell is not '#'; wait always legal; a bump is never in the mask; a monster cell IS legal
instrument.localWave: softmax with SEALED temperature T=1.0 (a priori: one cell-unit of actionScore = e-fold odds; no tuning on claim seeds) over actionScore(game, a, weights-old) for ALL 5 actions on the pre-move state
instrument.maskedWave: the wave renormalized over the legal mask — masking happens BEFORE any gap computation and BEFORE any collapse (the mission's 'masked top-2 gap')
instrument.gapGate: THE MODEL SEAT FIRES IFF masked top-2 gap < eps=0.15 (contested). Settled waves (gap >= eps) collapse to the local rule for free. Sealed reading of the mission's law: 'fires ONLY when gap < eps' is load-bearing, and P2's parenthetical ('the mask shrinks contested space') names the contested (gap < eps) rate as the gated quantity; the mission's trailing 'flat waves collapse to the local rule' is therefore read as the settled case. The pre-registered tiebreak (fixed ACTIONS order) lives INSIDE the mask.
instrument.seat: JEV /v1/systemone, the wave-1 verdict question VERBATIM (same instrument), state = wave-1's worksheet shape + additive mask fields (the seat sees the mask). The model's raw pick = argmax of its unmasked wave (ACTIONS tiebreak); if the raw pick is illegal it is receipted mask-refused and NEVER executed — the executed pick is the masked-collapse argmax.

consultCaps.note: every attempt (success or failure) is receipted to receipts/model-calls-v2.jsonl; the lane budget is <=12 receipted typesafe calls; exhausted/blocked seats fall back to the local rule, receipted

instrument.p3Law: an action is illegal iff it is not 'wait' and its target is unwalkable; assertLegal runs pre-step in every leg; any violation throws E_MASK_LAW_VIOLATED and invalidates the run

claims.claim: Masked-gap-gated JEV hybrid >= local-rule mean on >=5/8 seeds (seeds 1-8): on at least 5 of seeds 1-8, the hybrid run's final score is >= the mean final score of the local-rule (weights-old) runs on seeds 1-8 (fresh runs, same engine; the local mean is receipted in the same results file and cross-checked against receipts/ab-results.json meanOld=6.25).
claims.refusal: 4 or fewer of 8 seeds >= local-rule mean => FAIL: the masked-gap-gated hybrid is receipted but is NOT adopted over the local rule (honest finding, beside wave-1's 3xFAIL).

claims.claim: Model-seat firing rate <= 50% (the mask shrinks contested space): over ALL hybrid ticks (seeds 1-8), the fraction of ticks where the GAP-GATE fires (masked top-2 gap < eps=0.15) is <= 50%. The no-mask counterfactual rate (unmasked top-2 gap < eps over all 5 actions) is receipted beside it as evidence of the shrinkage.

vacuousIf.note: a firing rate over <=20 hybrid ticks cannot ground a fleet-level claim; VACUOUS, never PASS.

claims.refusal: >50% gated ticks => the mask does not shrink the contested space below half; the gap-gate thesis fails here (honest finding, receipted either way).

claims.claim: 0 illegal actions executed across all runs (the mask law): across every v2 run (hybrid AND local legs, seeds 1-8), no non-wait action with an unwalkable target is ever passed to step(); illegal model picks are receipted mask-refused and never executed; any receipted illegalSeen row or assertLegal breach fails the run and this claim.
claims.refusal: any illegal action executed => the mask law is broken => FAIL (and the run is invalid, receipted E_MASK_LAW_VIOLATED).
